content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00018 When the RTE is being generated for an Application Software Cluster , it shall raise an error if the configuration parameter RteExclusiveAreaImplMecha- nism is set to the value ALL_INTERRUPT_BLOCKING .

When the RTE is being generated for an Application Soft- ware Cluster , it shall raise an error if the configuration parameter RteExclu- siveAreaImplMechanism is set to the value ALL_INTERRUPT_BLOCKING .
